rationale: Central-bank register hub for all licensed payment/e-money actors; durable snowball root, failed URL is soft signal only.
Authoritative EMI register; new entrants and revocations surface here first.
Licensed payment-system operators register (KIBS etc.) — small but decisive payments-infrastructure actor set.
Master roster of licensed banks and savings houses; foundational actor list for the MK cell.
Savings-house section is a sub-page of the NBRSM banking-system pages already monitored.
Per-institution and aggregate financial data section; recurring quantitative feed.
Core recurring supervisory indicator dataset (capital, NPLs, profitability) for the banking system.
Release calendar converts ad-hoc scraping into a scheduled pipeline and flags late releases.
Single regulatory decision defining bank disclosure obligations — one-off legal artifact, key evidence for A1 corpus shape.
Supervision and regulation hub; durable root for prudential-disclosure sub-sources.
Recurring annual-report series covering banking and payment-system developments, EN editions available.
Periodic financial stability report series with banking risk and digital-payments chapters.
Payments oversight umbrella section; primary standing root for the payments half of the cell.
MIPS documentation sits under the payment-systems section already monitored; static infrastructure reference.
KIBS oversight page is a sub-page of the payment-systems hub; flags KIBS as a separate actor to scout.
Payment statistics time series (cards, POS, ATMs, volumes) — highest-value quantitative feed for terminal/acceptance sizing.
Credit registry micro-data restricted; page value unclear beyond documentation, revisit after liveness check.
Exchange-office register is a lead list to mine once for cash-cycle actors, not a continuous signal producer.
Licensing-procedure page under the payment services section; mostly static process description.
Primary legislation text — a fixed artifact defining the regulated-actor taxonomy, not a recurring feed.
Press-release stream: licences, regulation, reports — highest-frequency early-warning feed in the cell.
Payments council page sits under the payment-systems hub; useful for membership and strategy signals.
Bank routing-number reference list to mine once as a join key across NBRSM datasets.
FOI catalogue to mine once as an inventory of unpublished holdings and a request route.
Central bank's own accounts add little to commercial banking/payments intelligence; low incremental value.
Institution profile in the gov services catalogue; redundant mirror of NBRSM, useful only as fallback.
Statutory MSE issuer disclosure portal, densest A1 stream, but legal/terms status unclear — human must clear use.
